headline: Steady quarter as margin edges up and fee income dips
summary_short: EPS was $0.33 (adjusted $0.38), unchanged q/q; net interest margin rose 4bp to 3.25% while noninterest income fell 8% to $722M.
summary_long: Net interest income grew 1% q/q on higher securities yields and lower funding costs. Average loans slipped 0.4% on lower CRE and consumer balances; average deposits rose 0.2%. ROTCE was 14.6% (16.6% adjusted) and the efficiency ratio 61.2%. The net charge-off ratio rose to 0.31% from 0.25%. Huntington repurchased $100M of shares and cites synergies from the Veritex and Cadence partnerships. The release gives no numeric guidance.
confidence_notes: Shard sourceLink pointed at a dividend-declaration exhibit; the earnings release was found via web search (EDGAR exhibit under the prior accession). Y/y EPS is lower in part because share count rose after the Veritex and Cadence acquisitions (net interest income $1,506M a year ago). Adjusted EPS, ROTCE adjusted and efficiency ratio are non-GAAP.

drivers.explanation: Higher yields on investment securities and modestly lower overall net funding costs.
Lower capital markets fees and unfavorable equity valuation adjustments.
CEO says the franchise showed disciplined execution, with increasing benefits from the Veritex and Cadence partnerships and cost and revenue synergies on target.
